network_scope.note: The reviewed launch-stage USDC service used the Ethereum network.

customer_scope.note: Limited to customers accepted by SBI VC Trade under its account, jurisdiction, eligibility, and compliance rules.

conditions.description: SBI VC Trade announced a JPY 1 million-equivalent limit per buy/sell transaction at the reviewed launch stage.
Availability and execution remain subject to SBI VC Trade service terms, maintenance, compliance checks, and platform controls.

legal_route.description: The JFSA register dated 2026-06-24 lists SBI VC Trade as a registered electronic payment instrument service provider handling USDC.
